author: CBR
description:
Why are villains more memorable than heroes? Sierra Nutkevitch breaks down why characters like Joker and Darth Vader stick in our heads. 

From Batman’s Joker to Star Wars’ Darth Vader, the best movie villains don’t need us to see ourselves in them, they just need to dominate the story.
